attempts.rationale: I want to test a simple robust baseline, the mean of the full pool, given the trend-dominated regime and the hint to use a robust combination.

test a weighted combination using softmax_neg_error on a smaller, diverse pool1 to see if less correlated models improve robustness in a trend-dominated series.
test a weighted combination on the full pool using softmax_neg_error to see if a different weight scheme beats the current best; the trend-dominated regime suggests robust weighting may help.

test a trimmed_mean on a smaller, diverse pool (pool1) to see if trimming improves robustness given trend-dominated, unstable ranking.

decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8299. Series context: trend strength 0.866 and seasonal strength 0.115; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.158); 5 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.042.
